claims.text: The experiment was evaluated by analyzing learning curves for different models and their performance with varying hyperparameters.
The average similarity between hotels in the same market was calculated to assess how well market-level information was encoded in the embeddings.
The model's ability to predict a user's next click was measured using the hits@k metric, comparing performance across different scenarios.
